rationale: Base d6fa2c4a. AD-338 and epic #880 W2-G. Two new owner modules join the ir component: archkeel.ir.reference_contexts (facts-codec inner component, moved out of facts_validation.py) and archkeel.ir.dependency_binding_kinds (evidence inner component, with its public bound_sections). The function archkeel.ir.dependency_binding_kinds.bound_sections joins the public list of ir because archkeel.check.observation calls it. No budget rises, and no rule, requires entry or Any permission changes.
